responsibility: This file implements gengtype’s recursive-descent parser for the GTY-relevant subset of C and C++ declarations. Working on top of the lexer interface from gengtype.h, it tokenizes and parses structs, unions, enums, typedefs, declarators, inheritance fragments, GTY markers, and rooted variables, diagnoses unsupported constructs in automatically scanned types, and converts the accepted declarations into gengtype’s internal type, field, typedef, and variable records for later GC/PCH code generation.
